## Addendum for the decision: the single-leg half is implemented; one more shape the same cause read would decide

`domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `marchtian` · `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ` · 2026-10-10T09:58Z. ⛔ Not a ruling and not a re-presentation. This adds two facts to the card as filed.

1. **#22606's half is built and reviewed.** PR #22666 reads the recorded cancel cause for a single-leg roster beside an attested sibling. The contract-review record `6096338720` reads **PASS** on head `80e3b2313`, and the PR goes to the queue once CI is green. The mechanism option B would extend therefore exists: `classifyCancelAnnotations` and the attempt-jobs read in `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`. B is a second caller of it, not a new reader.
2. **A residual the review names**, which only B's direction would reach: a run in which **every** leg of a gate reads `cancelled` with zero credentials still passes as a supersession under #3668, without a cause read. So a run whose `dogfood` matrix and `dogfood-verify` were both killed by their own timeouts, with nothing superseding it, still reads green. In the measured 51-hour window that shape occurred 0 times as an own-timeout. The 47 both-cancelled dogfood runs were all supersessions, and so was every all-shards-cancelled `Test Core` run. If B is chosen, the follow-up dispatch can read the cause on this shape too, so that "superseded" is a recorded fact rather than a count, at the cost of one read on a path that is today free.

**The decision being asked is unchanged:** A / B / C, as filed.

## Triage: grade only, `tooling` · `priority:p1` · `domain:devx` · `area:devpath`. `needs-user-decision` stays: re-opening a recorded ruling (#16157 A) is the maintainer's

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T10:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** the attestation judge (`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`) and the two aggregate jobs are `domain:devx`, as #16157 and #22606 were.
- **Why p1:** two **required** contexts went red 139 times in 51 h with 0 real catches, about 71 of them on `main` pushes. A required red that is usually noise teaches every seat to ignore red. That is the failure mode the required gates exist to prevent.
- **For the presentation, from the card:** the proposed reading fails closed. An unreadable or unknown cancel cause stays red, which is today's ruling A, so it can never turn into a false green.
- **The new grant is a security fact:** `actions: read` and `checks: read` on the two aggregate jobs. It is read-only, but it is a workflow permission change, so the ruling should name it.
- **Not touched:** #22606 (the single-leg killed leg) is being built on PR #22666 under the current ruling. It does not wait for this decision.

Ruling: batch #312 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-10T11:33Z

Director seat, summon #36, `session_019fWAt2renophxLVg5aJXMH` (GitHub `hotlong`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Batch #312 (two cards, this one first) was presented in chat with this seat's own readings and the recommendation B, fallback A; the maintainer answered 「同意」, which takes the recommendation. Freshness gate: the body and both comments (the seat's addendum 6096349941 and triage's grade 6096366764) were re-read before this record; PR #22666 merged at 10:56Z and #22606 closed, so the cause reader B extends is on `main`. Thread-read: 6096366764.

## The ruling

- **B — on the partial-attestation path, the required check decides by the cancel cause the platform recorded.** When a leg's aggregate result is `cancelled` and at least one shard attested, `judge()` reads the cancelled jobs' check-run annotations through the reader PR #22666 landed (`classifyCancelAnnotations` and the attempt-jobs read in `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`): superseded by a higher-priority request ⇒ pass, as #3668 passes a whole-matrix supersession; killed by its own timeout ⇒ red, naming the shard; unreadable, or any other cause (a manual cancel included) ⇒ red. Both gates (`Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`). The `Test Core` aggregate job gains `actions: read` and `checks: read`, read-only, named here because a workflow permission change is a security fact.
- **#16157's ruling (5559243179) is amended, not reversed.** Its purpose, that a shard killed mid-suite never turns the required check green, stands; its proxy, "a sibling attested ⇒ not superseded", measured true 1 time in 157, is replaced by the recorded cause. A GitHub wording change degrades to that ruling's reading (red), never to a false green.
- **Not extended, decided here so nothing returns to the box:** the whole-matrix-cancelled path with zero attestations keeps #3668's count-based pass without a cause read. The seat's addendum (6096349941) measured that shape 0 times as an own-timeout kill in the window; adding a read to a path that is free today is a new gate with no measured catch. It is an acceptance note on the execution, not a build.
- ⛔ **Not taken:** A (keep the ruling as read: about 65 required-check reds a day on dead SHAs, half on `main` pushes, teaching every seat to ignore red) and C (back to #3668: a shard killed mid-suite greens the required check over untested packages, the defect #16157 closed).

## Why B on the first axis

It replaces an inference with the platform's recorded fact and fails closed where the fact is missing; it adds no gate and no script, one read on one branch of `judge()`. GitHub's own required-check model reads the same way: a cancelled check is neither a success nor a failure until something states why.

Prior rulings read: #16157 (5559243179, batch #54 「同意」) and its cost note (5556849727); #3668; #22606 and PR #22666 (merged 10:56Z, head 80e3b2313, contract review PASS 6096338720); `judge()` at `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs:264-340`; the annotations on jobs 114005072147 (superseded) and 114123251343 (own timeout); run 38036705318 (`Test Core (5/6)` success, five cancelled, aggregate failure); AGENTS.md § Route & surface ownership, rule 3; thread: 6096366764. 自检:只看①选 B;②③④是否翻转:否。

## State and execution

- `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act; `tooling`, `priority:p1`, `domain:devx`, `area:devpath` unchanged, no assignee. The body gains its `Ruled:` line in the same act.
- Execution: one `domain:devx` dispatch on top of PR #22666's reader: the partial path of `judge()` for both gates, its batteries (a superseded partial matrix ⇒ pass; an own-timeout partial ⇒ red naming the shard; an unreadable cause ⇒ red), and the `Test Core` aggregate job's `permissions`. `Clause-②: yes`, as #16157 set for a required-check semantics change; one contract-review-tier review before the queue. Workload by precedent (PR #22666, +660/−19, 2 files): a second caller of the same reader, roughly 150–300 lines, 1 PR.
